title: Action View & Helpers
intro: Rails views are deliberately thin — the business logic lives in models and services, the view just presents it. This page covers the view layer topics that appear in intermediate interviews: layout inheritance and content_for/yield, partials with locals (and the performance difference between render collection: vs looping), form_with and how it generates CSRF tokens, the security risk of html_safe and raw, helper methods vs decorators vs ViewComponent, and the asset pipeline evolution (Sprockets → Webpacker → importmap). The XSS question hides in the view layer — 'when does Rails escape HTML and when doesn't it?' — and the answer requires knowing that ERB auto-escapes via <%= %> but raw and html_safe bypass that protection.
